source_scope.candidate_join_status: source-artifact-scoped only; the sealed C12 source artifact does not declare a stable local candidate id for this Replay Gap evidence branch, and no canonical key is guessed before a final C12 pair exists
source_scope.mechanism_under_audit: Replay Gap live branching-rollout methodology as an executable replay/reconstruction substrate for evaluating historical rollback-target selectors, especially the claim that prefix replay fidelity rules out environment reconstruction error

external_primary_artifact.paper: The Replay Gap: Static Evaluation of Model Switching in LLM Agents Scores the Wrong World, arXiv:2608.08239 / Efficient Reasoning Workshop at COLM 2026
external_primary_artifact.released_dataset: ashritha0907/replay-gap-trajectories on Hugging Face; dataset card states ~900 rollouts and fields including replay_fidelity/replay_mismatches
external_primary_artifact.dependency_pin: mini-swe-agent==2.4.5 is pinned; datasets and pyyaml are unpinned, while vllm and swebench are installed separately without a pinned version in requirements.txt

published_or_official_claims.branching_protocol: Fresh container, replay recorded prefix actions, seed recorded message prefix, then continue live with swap or same-model control.
published_or_official_claims.fidelity_claim: Paper and dataset card report 99.99% return-code agreement across 11,702 replayed actions and describe 707/708 branches as reconstructing exactly.
published_or_official_claims.headline_action_result: Across six paired runs, swap arms exceed same-model control divergence; paper reports pooled normalized edit distance 0.941 vs 0.674 for up@early and 0.895 vs 0.232 for down@early, with additional late-arm differences.
published_or_official_claims.scope: One mini-SWE-agent scaffold, SWE-bench Verified, Qwen3-4B FP8 vs Qwen3-14B AWQ, two fork positions and constrained serving budget; outcome claims rest on five observed flips.

mechanical_code_audit.what_replay_prefix_actions_actually_chec: branching.py parses recorded <returncode> values, re-executes each recorded action, and stores replayed_returncode, recorded_returncode and match=(replayed_returncode == recorded_returncode). It does not compare stdout/stderr text, observation payloads, filesystem/repository tree state, process state, environment variables, timestamps, network-visible state, or a post-prefix environment hash.
mechanical_code_audit.what_replay_fidelity_exact_means_in_code: scripts/replay_fidelity.py defines a branch as perfect exactly when all comparable per-action return-code matches are true. Its printed 'branches exact' field is therefore return-code-perfect, not a mechanically verified equality of reconstructed environment state.
mechanical_code_audit.branch_message_semantics: After replay, the branch model is seeded with the recorded prefix messages, not the fresh replay outputs. This intentionally gives identical model-visible prefix text, but also means a replayed environment can differ silently while the model sees the recorded observation.
mechanical_code_audit.result_artifact_support: The repository contains the core branching/metric code, experiment config, six committed per-run divergence JSON files, a large summary JSON, analysis scripts, paper source and a no-GPU smoke test. This is strong official artifact support for re-analysis and rerun attempts.

independent_sanity_check.type: criterion counterexample executed locally; not a reproduction of the paper's GPU experiment
independent_sanity_check.procedure: Executed the same state-writing shell command twice using `date +%s%N > state.txt`. Both executions returned code 0 while the resulting file contents differed.
independent_sanity_check.implication: A return-code-only fidelity criterion can label a replay perfect while material environment state differs. This proves the current criterion is insufficient to establish exact reconstruction, although it does not show that the released Replay Gap branches actually suffered such hidden drift.

independent_replication_search.result: No protocol-matched independent rerun of the released six-run Replay Gap experiment was located in fresh exact-title/repository/dataset searches. Secondary pages and community discussion summarize the paper but do not constitute an independent numerical reproduction.
independent_replication_search.scope_guard: Absence in this search is not proof that no reproduction exists.

assessment.headline_action_level_numerical_reproduc: B+; raw/derived trajectory data, committed divergence outputs and analysis code are public, but this audit did not execute the GPU+Docker six-run protocol or an independent full-data reanalysis
assessment.claim_707_of_708_reconstruct_exactly: C as currently evidenced; the released aggregation equates exactness with all return codes matching and does not verify full environment-state equality
assessment.selector_testbed_readiness: B; live-branch methodology and same-model controls are strong, but a rollback-selector study should strengthen checkpoint/reconstruction validation before treating target-arm differences as isolated from hidden restore drift

downstream_correction.safe_wording: Treat Replay Gap as strong official evidence that live post-intervention branching can differ radically from static stitched replay and as a useful reconstruction/control-fork methodology. Replace '707/708 branches reconstructed exactly' with '707/708 branches had no observed return-code mismatch across comparable replayed prefix actions' unless stronger state-equivalence evidence is supplied.
do_not_infer: Do not infer that the environment state was byte-for-byte or semantically identical merely from return-code agreement.

Do not infer that this fidelity limitation invalidates the paper's observed action-divergence results; same-model controls reduce reconstruction/sampling confounding, and the official data/artifacts remain substantial evidence.
Do not infer that Replay Gap already supplies a standardized historical rollback-target selector benchmark; that remains a proposed transfer in the long_horizon worker.
downstream_correction.recommended_selector_harness_guard: At each restored target, record at minimum a repository/filesystem tree digest for task-relevant state plus deterministic summaries of relevant environment/tool state and replayed observation digests, and pair every intervention arm with a same-policy reconstruction control under equal post-fork budget.

reproducibility_blockers: Full six-run rerun requires an x86_64 Docker SWE-bench setup, large disk and the two model-serving stacks; the audit environment did not have these dependencies/network available.
vLLM and SWE-bench versions are not pinned in requirements.txt, so exact future reruns need an environment/container manifest beyond the current Python requirements.
No stronger committed replay-state hash/observation-equivalence audit was located; the published 707/708 exact wording is therefore narrower than it appears.
exact_next_action: For this evidence branch, first look for any released VM/container/environment manifest or hidden-to-current-search replay audit that compares task-relevant state or replayed observation content rather than return codes. If none exists, do not repeat source-only inspection; rotate to another under-audited C12 namespace with executable artifacts. If the C12 final canonical pair later exposes a stable long_horizon source_local_candidate_id for this mechanism, attach this immutable audit mechanically by exact source_artifact_blob plus that declared id rather than guessing a key.
